classification: Source-only async diagnostic/harness correctness blocker; no product/API runtime failure or credential disclosure observed
observation: bounded() Promise.race returns after timer but does not cancel or settle underlying operation. finish() wraps failureReads12s (DOM3s) without tracking/awaiting underlying read promises; failureRead awaits unbounded response.dispose then calls add, and failureReads may start new GETs after finish returned. add has no ended guard.
static_counterexample: SESSION GET/json finishes and sets actorIsExpected true; response.dispose remains unresolved beyond outer12s
finish timeout catches, records END/diagnosticCompleted=false, clears token and returns to original sanitizer/fixture teardown
dispose later resolves; failureRead appends SESSION event after END and failureReads starts additional GETs with cleared/undefined token, possibly during next original test or context teardown
impact: Source guarantee of observer async settlement before test teardown is false; closed observations may be changed after END or reflect a later case. Resource guard can eventually reap processes but does not restore per-case temporal correctness.
minimal_required_correction: Keep/settle all started observer read work or explicitly stop/cancel it; prevent any post-timeout/post-END new request or persist callback and clear token in guaranteed final cleanup. Preserve original test assertions/status, readonly UI-token policy, closed facts and bounded overall deadline. Source-only finite controls should model delayed dispose/callback and confirm no post-END GET/persist.

classification: Source-only bearer/own-GET destination boundary blocker; actual redirect/network/credential exposure NOT_EXECUTED
observation: failureRead sends UI-issued Authorization header but omits maxRedirects. Pinned Playwright1.59.1 server/fetch defaults to20 redirects, clones headers/removes cookie only and forwards to new URL without stripping Authorization for foreign origin. Initial relative loopback URL therefore does not enforce own target for entire request.
static_counterexample: A301/302/307/308 Location pointing to another origin causes fetch to follow it with copied UI bearer header before observer sees final status/body; no real request executed.
impact: Violates explicitly promised bounded own-GET/private bearer scope if an unexpected redirect/misrouting occurs. Canonical SafeReporter and sanitized artifacts do not control network destination.
minimal_required_correction: For new observer diagnostic GETs disallow automatic redirects (maxRedirects0) and classify unexpected3xx safely; retain exact HTTPS loopback target, own-token/current-actor check, no retries/newlogin/write. Do not alter vendor/original test assertions.
